title: API keys
subtitle: API keys let applications and people call the LLM Hub API. Each key belongs to a project, a person, or you, and its spend counts toward that budget.

gettingStarted.title: Getting started
gettingStarted.subtitle: Connect a provider, add a model, then create an API key. After that, try the Playground.

empty: {canManage, select, yes {An API key lets an application or a person call the hub. Creating one takes under a minute: name it, choose who uses it, and pick its models.} other {An API key lets an application or a person call the hub. There is no key you can see yet.}}

overview.inactive: {count, plural, one {# paused or blocked} other {# paused or blocked}}

fields.templatesHint: Preset rules stay current as models change. <link>Manage presets</link>
fields.templatesNote: Preset rules stay current as models change.
fields.modelsHint: Allowed in addition to the selected presets.
fields.maxRequestCostHint: Rejects a single request whose estimated cost is higher, before it reaches a provider. Callers can lower it per request with the x-hub-max-cost header. Leave empty for no limit.
fields.allowedIpsHint: One IP address per line. Leave empty to allow any address.
fields.endpointsHint: Leave empty to allow every endpoint. The model list (/api/v1/models) always stays available.
fields.logContentHint: When off, request logs for this key keep only metadata, no prompts or responses.
fields.aliasHint: A name you will recognise later, for example the app and its environment.
fields.rpmHint: Requests above this rate get HTTP 429. Leave empty for no limit.
fields.tpmHint: Input and output tokens together. Leave empty for no limit.
fields.budgetHint: Requests are blocked once this key has spent this amount in the period. Leave empty for no own limit. Budgets of the project, department, and company still apply.
fields.expiryOption: {days, select, 0 {Never} 30 {30 days} 90 {90 days} 365 {1 year} other {{days, number, integer} days}}
fields.expiryNever: The key keeps working until you revoke it.
fields.blockedHint: A blocked key rejects every request until you unblock it, and an alert goes out when you block it.

windows.title: Allowed times
windows.hint: Without time windows, the key works at any time. With windows, requests outside all of them are rejected. Queued batches still finish.

windows.dayName: {day, select, mon {Monday} tue {Tuesday} wed {Wednesday} thu {Thursday} fri {Friday} sat {Saturday} other {Sunday}}
windows.timeZoneHint: Days and times follow this time zone, including daylight saving changes.

revokeConfirm.title: Revoke {name}?
revokeConfirm.description: The key is deleted and every request that uses it is rejected right away. This cannot be undone.

rotateConfirm.title: Rotate {name}?
rotateConfirm.description: A new secret is created and shown once. The current secret keeps working for one hour and is then rejected, so update every client within that hour.

pause.title: Pause {name}
pause.description: Requests with this key are rejected with key_paused until it is resumed. Its settings, budget, and secret stay as they are, and batches already queued still finish.
pause.hours: {hours, select, 0 {Until resumed} 1 {1 hour} 24 {1 day} 168 {7 days} other {{hours, number, integer} hours}}
pause.until: {timed, select, yes {Resumes on its own on {until}.} other {Stays paused until someone resumes it.}}

mcp.title: MCP access for {name}
mcp.description: Choose which MCP servers this key can use and what each tool may do. A rule on the key is the most specific one: its role wins, and blocks set for the company, department, project, or person still apply.
mcp.loadFailed: The MCP access of this key could not be loaded.
mcp.emptyDescription: Connect a server or build one with MCP Anything under MCP servers, then come back to set this key's access.

mcp.actionsHint: Tools of an unchecked kind stay hidden for this key.
